To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) more stringent product and/or labour market regulations are negatively related to investment and the capital stock; (ii) this relationship is stronger at higher levels of EPL; (iii) product market regulations amplify the negative relationship between EPL and investment and the capital stocks; and (iv) the quality of institutions (the rule of law) mitigates the negative impact of regulations on investment.
more stringent product market regulations (PMRs) and more stringent labour market regulations (LMRs) are associated with lower investment (capital stock).
